quandoUsar: A short, ordered set of items of the same kind, such as products or case studies, where the neighbors in view signal that there is more.
Touch navigation (drag, quick swipe, horizontal trackpad gesture) with equivalent arrows, indicators, and keyboard.
Optional automatic rotation with a visible pause button, via `interval`.
quandoEvitar: Use `marquee` for a strip that scrolls on its own without stopping at each item, such as a row of logos.
Use `image-viewer` for photos that need to open enlarged, with zoom.
Use `card-stack` when the user decides on each item instead of just browsing.

teclado.acao: Go to the previous or next slide, with focus anywhere in the carousel outside text fields.
Go to the first or last slide.
Moves through the slides area, the active slide's content, the rotation button, the selected indicator, and the two arrows.
Trigger the focused button: pause or start rotation, choose a slide, previous or next.

acessibilidade: The `section` has `aria-roledescription="carousel"` and the name from `label`; each slide is a `tabpanel` labeled by `slideLabel`, and the indicators form a `tablist` in which only the selected one is in the tab order.
Slides away from the center are `inert`: links and buttons inside them only work on the active slide, and a manual change is announced in an `aria-live` region.
Rotation pauses on mouse hover, on keyboard focus, while dragging, off screen, and with the tab hidden; the control labels (“Next slide”, “Pause slide rotation”) are in English in the code.
movimento: The track goes to the slide with a no-overshoot spring, carrying the gesture's velocity; at the ends it resists like an elastic band.

Slides shrink to 90% and fade to 50% as they move away from the center, and the indicator stretches into a pill that travels along with it, frame by frame; during rotation, the pill empties until the swap.
With “reduce motion”, the track jumps to the slide and automatic rotation is unavailable (the button does not even appear).
responsivo: The root is a size container and needs a defined width; `slideSize` (default `min(80cqw, 340px)`) accepts any CSS length, and `cqw` is the fraction of the carousel's width.
With a container up to 340 px the controls row tightens; the slides area uses `touch-action: pan-y`, so the vertical gesture scrolls the page.
desempenho: All slides stay mounted and read the track position on every frame for scale and opacity: keep the set short.
With `interval`, an `IntersectionObserver` and the page visibility event pause rotation when no one is looking.
notasIA: Each child is a slide (give it a stable `key`) and `label` is required; index controlled with `index` and `onIndexChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultIndex`.
`interval` (ms per slide) only adds the rotation button; it starts stopped, unless you pass `autoplay`.
There is no loop: the arrows stop at the first and last slide, and only automatic rotation returns to the start.
